# Analytics Vidhya

> > The ultimate destination for Generative AI, Data Science, and Data Engineering education with hands-on projects, certifications, and industry mentorship.

Analytics Vidhya is a comprehensive learning platform offering free and premium courses, certification programs, live events, and competitions in AI/ML. The platform combines educational content with community engagement through DataHack competitions, DataHour webinars, and the DataHack Summit conference.

## Key Topics

- Generative AI
- Agentic AI
- Large Language Models (LLMs)
- Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Machine Learning
- Deep Learning
- Python
- LangChain & LangGraph
- ChatGPT & OpenAI
- Data Science
- Prompt Engineering
- AI Agents
- Certification Programs
- Mentorship
- Career Development

## Core Learning Programs

- [Free Generative AI, ML & DL Courses](https://www.analyticsvidhya.com/courses): Free online courses in AI, ML, deep learning and generative AI.
- [GenAI Pinnacle Plus Program](https://www.analyticsvidhya.com/pinnacleplus): GenAI Pinnacle Plus covering LLMs, agentic AI and advanced curriculum.
- [Certified AI/ML BlackBelt Plus Program](https://blackbelt.analyticsvidhya.com): BlackBelt Plus certification program in AI/ML with mentorship and placement.
- [Agentic AI Pioneer Program](https://www.analyticsvidhya.com/agenticaipioneer): Agentic AI Pioneer Program with LangChain, LangGraph and mentorship.
- [Generative AI Course Online](https://www.analyticsvidhya.com/courses/genai-a-way-of-life): Free GenAI course covering ChatGPT, DALL-E and generative AI tools.

## Advanced AI Programs & Accelerators

- [AI Accelerator Program | Building Agentic AI Systems](https://www.analyticsvidhya.com/ai-accelerator-program/building-and-evaluating-agentic-ai-systems): AI Accelerator live program on agentic AI systems with LangChain and RAG.
- [AI Accelerator Program | Mastering RAG Systems](https://www.analyticsvidhya.com/ai-accelerator-program/mastering-rag-from-foundations-to-advanced-agentic-rag-systems): AI Accelerator program covering RAG systems and agentic AI applications.
- [Enterprise AI Solutions](https://www.analyticsvidhya.com/enterprise): Enterprise AI solutions and workforce upskilling for organizations.

## Content & Learning Resources

- [Analytics Vidhya Blog](https://analyticsvidhya.com/blog): Blog hub featuring AI, GenAI, LLM tutorials and learning resources.
- [Roadmap to Become Data Scientist in 2025](https://www.analyticsvidhya.com/blog/2020/12/a-comprehensive-learning-path-to-become-a-data-scientist): Data scientist learning roadmap covering Python, SQL, ML and deep learning.

## Community & Competitions

- [DataHack Platform](https://datahack.analyticsvidhya.com): DataHack platform with competitions, hackathons and data science challenges.
- [DataHack Summit 2026](https://www.analyticsvidhya.com/datahacksummit): DataHack Summit 2026 AI conference in Bengaluru with keynotes and networking.

## Events & Industry Insights

- [DataHour: Expert-Led Sessions](https://www.analyticsvidhya.com/events/datahour): DataHour live webinar series with industry experts on GenAI and data science.
- [Leading with Data Podcast Series](https://www.analyticsvidhya.com/events/leading-with-data): Leading with Data podcast series featuring industry leaders on AI and data.
